title: University of Arkansas at Little Rock (UARK)
summary: University of Arkansas at Little Rock (UARK) is a university in Little Rock. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with UARK.

sections.heading: What UARK is known for
paragraphs: The University of Arkansas at Little Rock (UARK) is a public institution known for its diverse academic offerings and significant enrollment. With an undergraduate population of 4,949 students, UARK provides a range of programs that attract a broad student body. The university has an admission rate of approximately 58.78%, reflecting a moderately selective admissions process.

UARK is particularly recognized for its strong emphasis on health-related programs, which constitute about 23.44% of its academic offerings. Additionally, business programs represent roughly 10.96% of the university's curriculum, highlighting its commitment to preparing students for careers in these fields. As a public university, UARK serves the educational needs of the region with a focus on accessible and comprehensive higher education.

sections.heading: How to read UARK tuition
paragraphs: The University of Arkansas at Little Rock (UARK) provides distinct tuition rates for in-state and out-of-state students. In-state tuition is set at $9,748, reflecting the reduced cost for Arkansas residents. Out-of-state students are charged a higher tuition rate of $22,158. The overall cost of attendance, which includes tuition along with additional expenses such as fees, housing, and supplies, totals $22,519. Understanding these figures helps prospective students and families anticipate the financial commitment associated with attending UARK.
